layers.name: Frontend Presentation Layer
layers.description: Contains UI components, layout definitions, and navigation services for the application's user interface.

layers.name: Core Business Logic
layers.description: Manages core application services, security, AI integration, and domain-specific business workflows.

layers.name: Persistence and Migration
layers.description: Handles database connections, multi-vendor data source configurations, and schema migration services.

layers.name: Shared Helper Utilities
layers.description: Provides common helper classes for tasks like QR code generation, logging, URL manipulation, and dice rolling.

layers.name: System Configuration Management
layers.description: Manages application settings, environment configurations, and external metadata for system integration.

layers.name: Core Domain Model
layers.description: Contains the primary business entities, repositories, and domain logic for managing wrestlers, shows, and user accounts.

layers.name: Verification and Testing
layers.description: Provides a comprehensive suite of integration, end-to-end, and controller tests to ensure system stability and security compliance.
